notablePrerequisites: At least six additional creatures in graveyard and/or on the battlefield.
description:
Cast Brilliant Restoration by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}{W}, returning all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Brilliant Restoration from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing Archaeomancer and six other creatures, adding seven {W}.
Repeat.
